text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Fukukitaru, Happy New Year! ♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, I'm so happy…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Happy about what, Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Well, last year I messed up our New Year's visit and ended up going to a shrine alone.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But I didn't make a single mistake this time! Maybe this is a sign of growth?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Why yes, of course it is! ☆ You're not the same Doto you used to be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto has become a little more resilient since that encounter with Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, just you wait. I'm going to give this year my all!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely be able to support Opera O. I know I can, because I've grown…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You've grown, huh?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, Shakur? Are you here to celebrate New Year's too?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Me? Course not. I'm just passing through, but more importantly…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Listen up, Doto. Don't go believing in things you can't put into numbers.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Growth, feelings, gods, wishes… Get caught up in that nonsense, and you'll lose sight of reality.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I said it before your debut, and I'll say it again. You need skill, not any of that good-luck junk.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't go tripping over yourself 'cause you've misread the info. See ya.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Air Shakur leaves, I get the odd feeling she was looking at me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: T-T-Trainer… Shakur isn't the type to make up lies. She's right—I'm just not talented enough…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, I agree! If you ask me, numbers make as much sense as rapping underwater.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Have faith in the gods, and you'll be on the correct path! The gods save the earth! Nothing can go astray if you have luck on the way! ☆

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That would be nice, but…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll need to do something this New Year's to win the blessing of the gods.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what do you think I should do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't want to push her so early in the year, so I think a small blessing will do. What could work as a cozy little adventure for her?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wow, chillaxing. ♪ Lounging about indoors with everyone sounds great.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: So it's settled! Why don't we sing a New Year's song to get in the chillaxing mood!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: La-la-la, la-di-da! ♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: La-di-da-di-daa! ♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, this is a lot of fun, but all I've contributed is a "yay" so far…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You're totally fine! It's New Year's—let me handle all the difficult parts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Relenting, Meisho Doto continues adding her own little contributions. She appears to be having a relaxing time.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A retreat in the mountains… It sounds like a lot of work.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I see… A follower of the gods is a practitioner of shugendo, and a practitioner of shugendo must train in the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now then! We should depart for those bitter, cold peaks where spirits roam free!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, the rice we cooked using the mess kit is good to go. It's steaming hot!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: And here's a really fluffy blanket. We can get nice and cozy with this.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What is this?! The only peaks I see are the tops of these tents! Are we just camping?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Well, not that it's a problem. ♪ A trip to the outdoors is stimulating in itself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pitching our tents, gathering kindling—we enjoy a little getaway from our everyday routines.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ooh! And did you know you can learn while you sleep? What an idea! A New Year's blessing.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, I think I've seen audiobooks that send info directly to your brain via headphones.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll put one of those on, and go take a nap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I don't know what to do! I can remember all these things, and it happened so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I must have memorized everything from the sleep-learning audiobooks. It all just soaked into my head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto, honest to a fault, has absorbed all the knowledge played back to her. I can see this information coming in handy later on.
